title: Page 110
transc:
430 pm to Beckwith  Washn July 6th 1864
Laura for Belly tulip Please give me an estimate
of number of dies mounted pekin sent in order
that I may provide remounts yard They should bring
their ridges with them stick It appears that Neptune
had no wardens out to give notice of racines
approach & he seems to guess at their numbers
pike estimating them from Cushing to over Oliver Seward
pike other estimates are from Nelson to Norris Dwight
tulip I think there is no further doubt about
Irelands Pelham pike probably also Ingrate Imboden Jamaica &
Moseby spike If so the invasion is of a
pretty formidable character ---- I have <unclear>hurried</unclear> meriden pack
but get no reply from him ---- I fear
that the Walnut is so much injured that his
pation trifle slow ---- Can you send a good
spunky shark to prospect Shylock Opinion till Meriden arrives
Stanhope I think lantern shld not leave haron lamb
